verdict.rationale: Clerk is an authentication and user-management platform, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence covers only the server and auth side of MCP: Clerk publishes its own MCP server for AI clients, offers custom OAuth scopes for MCP clients, and gates eve tool calls by permission. None of it shows Clerk itself plugging in external MCP servers to use their tools.
